Dennis Cirkin will also be missing through suspension for QPR, while there is uncertainty over Glen Kamara's potential involvement due to a dispute with Finland.

Nonetheless, Julien Stephan will need as many players available as possible due to a long injury list he has already had to deal with.

Still, the visitors are enjoying a stellar season where they find themselves in sixth after the international break. [...] Nuno Espirito Santo has continued his work from the top flight and despite a high turnover of players, the likes of Jarrod Bowen and Konstantinos Mavropanos have showed their Premier League class a division below.

The latter should be available despite suffering a small injury for Greece, but Mohamadou Kante is suspended after his sending off against Millwall. [...] West Ham United will elevate themselves to the top of the Championship table if they beat Queens Park Rangers at the London Stadium on Friday night.

After a long international break, the Hammers return to action after salvaging a 2-2 draw at Millwall last time out.

Meanwhile, QPR were also held to the same scoreline by Preston North End on home soil, and would leapfrog West Ham into second with victory themselves.

Konstantinos Mavropanos picked up a minor knock with Greece but should be fine.
